Every day, millions of people walk past New York's history, and never look up.
A gilded troublemaker. A bank that became a home. A studio where art history happened.
Look Up NYC tells you exactly where to look, and the story behind it. Just listen, and look around.
Every walk tells you how many steps it is, so you can hit your step goal while you soak up the city's history.
Exploring solo? It's like a local guide in your pocket, and you can share the walk with friends.
